summary: Tested new Service Catalog module (CRUD API), logo fix on /connexion page, and admin navigation. Found 1 bug: POST /api/v2/catalog returns 500 due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue.

issues.description: POST /api/v2/catalog returns 500 Internal Server Error due to MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue. The insert_one method in TenantRepository returns the document with _id field added by MongoDB, which cannot be JSON serialized.
issues.fix_suggestion: In /app/backend/services/database.py TenantRepository.insert_one(), remove _id from returned document: tenant_doc.pop('_id', None) before return

action_items: Fix POST /api/v2/catalog 500 error by removing _id from returned document in TenantRepository.insert_one()
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing admin user and seeded catalog services.

Mobile API v2 endpoints still working after catalog addition.
